title: Choose a research group
text: Why are you interested in this research group?

options.text: I only care about the university name.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。

options.text: I find the topic interesting but need to understand the daily work better.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。

options.text: The recent work matches a question I explored, and I want to learn the methods used.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。
